name: Token deployer or insider wallets distributing holdings into promoted price rise
description: Wallets linked to a token's creator, early allocation or liquidity pool move large balances to exchanges or fresh wallets as promotion drives the price up, often followed by liquidity removal.
fp: Vesting schedules, treasury management and disclosed team allocations can involve similar transfers. Check against published token schedules.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Securities Sector, 2009
European Union, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 on market abuse (Market Abuse Regulation), 2014
FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, 2020
